I need to understand the fundamental definitions of electrophiles and nucleophiles:

B. This is accurate - having unshared electron pairs doesn't prevent a species from being an electrophile if it has electron-deficient centers

D. This statement seems questionable - nucleophiles are defined by their ability to donate electron pairs, which typically requires having unshared electron pairs
